# Liberty Home Guard

> > Liberty Home Guard provides comprehensive home warranty protection plans covering appliances and home systems with customer-focused claims service.

Liberty Home Guard offers bundled warranty packages including Appliance Guard, Systems Guard, and Total Home Guard plans. The company partners with service providers like On Point Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning Inc., My Plumber, MJZ Solutions, and others to deliver home repair and maintenance coverage.
